page.overview:
Who is Exim Panshard?

Exim Panshard was a male Sith Lord who held the title of viceroy on a long forgotten planet. Yupe Tashu had obtained the mask. After conferring with the spirits of fallen Sith, he gifted the mask to the Pantoran Acolyte Kiza. When her boyfriend Remi demanded the mask for himself, Tashu chastised him for angering the fallen specters. He also confiscated Remi's lightsaber and gave it to Kiza. Under the influence of Panshard's mask, Kiza took part in an attack on a New Republic outpost on Devaron and killed Remi when he tried to reclaim his lightsaber.

Panshard's spirit made Kiza into his pawn on the promise she would get power if she brought him to the Sith planet Exegol, where he hoped he would be reborn to bring about a new era of Sith rule. However, Panshard's plans were ruined in 21 ABY after Jedi Master Luke Skywalker sensed his growing darkness. The quest for Exegol ended in defeat for Panshard; after Kiza was killed and he took full control over her body, Skywalker destroyed his mask before it could claim him as its vessel, ending the threat of Panshard once and for all.

Shadow of the Sith author Adam Christopher believes that Exim Panshard comes from an era before the Sith were an organized faction, thereby explaining why he lacks the Darth title.

Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy
